entities.name: Aleksander Jełowicki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aleksander Jełowicki was a Polish writer, poet, translator and publisher. He was a veteran of the November Uprising, deputy to the Sejm of Congress Poland for the Haisyn powiat and political exile in France, where he was a social activist, superior of the Polish Catholic Mission in Paris and monk.
